description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three language models — RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) — across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG (average). Each category features three grouped bars, color-coded as dark purple for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean, and light gray for SOLAR-10.7B. The vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.50 and 1.00. In PT-EVAL, RedWhale scores 0.42, EEVE-Korean 0.46, and SOLAR-10.7B 1.00. In KoBEST-BQ, RedWhale achieves 0.52, EEVE-Korean 0.56, and SOLAR-10.7B 1.00. For KoBEST-CP, RedWhale scores 0.71, EEVE-Korean 0.74, and SOLAR-10.7B 1.00. In KoBEST-HS, RedWhale scores 0.50, EEVE-Korean 0.54, and SOLAR-10.7B 1.00. For KoBEST-SN, RedWhale scores 0.69, EEVE-Korean 0.73, and SOLAR-10.7B 1.00. The AVG category shows RedWhale at 0.57, EEVE-Korean at 0.61, and SOLAR-10.7B at 1.00. Across all categories, SOLAR-10.7B consistently achieves the maximum score of 1.00, while RedWhale and EEVE-Korean show varying but lower scores, with EEVE-Korean generally outperforming RedWhale except in KoBEST-CP and KoBEST-SN where RedWhale is close. The chart visually emphasizes that while RedWhale is competitive, especially in KoBEST-CP and KoBEST-SN, it lags behind the base model SOLAR-10.7B, which serves as a performance ceiling in this evaluation.
